# GET /api/v1/settings/repository

Returns instance's global repository settings indicating which features are disabled

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** none · **ID:** `ep-017`

## Response

**200** — GeneralRepoSettings

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `mirrors_disabled` | bool | Whether repository mirroring is disabled |
| `http_git_disabled` | bool | Whether HTTP Git operations are disabled |
| `migrations_disabled` | bool | Whether repository migrations are disabled |
| `stars_disabled` | bool | Whether repository starring is disabled |
| `time_tracking_disabled` | bool | Whether time tracking is disabled |
| `lfs_disabled` | bool | Whether Git LFS support is disabled |
